metadata.summary: Jitin initiated a call with Manhattan Bagel but did not place an order, instead asking to hold for a moment and then ending the call.

messages.text: Hello Jitin Welcome to manhattan bagel It is great to see you again What would you like to order?
Hello again, Jitin. Welcome back to Manhattan Bagel. I am BagelBot. What would you like to order today?
I'm just looking to order, like one second, please.
Take your time, Jitin. I'm here when you're ready to order. What can I get for you today?
One second. One second. Hold on.
No rush, Jitin. Take all the time you need. I'll be here when you're ready to place your order.
